column1: # Kitchen LED Controller — custom OTA-capable partition table (TASK-107)
#   0x10000-0x12000  OTA data (otadata; selects the active OTA slot)
#   0x12000-0x20000  Coredump (56 KiB — flash backtrace storage; also pads the
#                    region up to the 64 KiB app-slot alignment boundary)
# Sizing rationale: the measured application image is far below 1 MiB
# 1792 KiB per OTA slot leaves a very large safety margin for future
# requires app partitions to be 64 KiB aligned
# so the coredump partition fills 0x12000-0x20000 to keep the table gap-free
# while keeping both OTA slots 64 KiB aligned.  The LittleFS partition gets
# the whole remaining tail of the 4 MiB flash (384 KiB)
